Even if it were above the horizon, a **5.75%-illuminated crescent only 27.7° from the Sun** would be challenging and would normally require looking shortly after sunset or before sunrise in a very clear sky. But at 19:25 AWST in Perth on 12 July 2026, it has already set long ago.

So your surprise is justified: **you cannot see it from Perth at that moment.**
